author: LoganPaul
text:
I’ve beaten Floyd Mayweather
I’ve become United States Champ
I’ve sold a Pokémon card for $16.5M

But no feat will be harder than my next. Tomorrow, I will attempt to catch my first ever Shiny Pokémon: 1 in 8,192 Odds

The Pokémon equivalent of hitting a hole in one

And not just any Pokémon… 

Steelix. One of my all time favorites. Shiny Steelix is a GOATED shiny, a pure 24k Gold TITAN. 

I won’t stop hunting until I catch a shiny Onix, then evolve him via trade + metal coat into Steelix. 

For every Pokémon encounter, we’ll add $1 to a prize pool. When I catch Shiny Onix, one lucky viewer will get the entire pot 💰

I could be hunting for days. And I’m live streaming all of it on my YouTube (LoganPaulVlogs) & Twitch (LoganPaulWasTaken) starting 12p EST
